note: The colors of the houses (plan 0004, R10a to R10c, and the report 0004, D-0004-09). "walls" are the muted wall colors measured from aerial photos of Vũng Tàu: about 70 % of the walls. "bold_walls" are the strong colors of the other walls: mint, teal, pastel yellow, salmon, sky blue, and two-color fronts. A bold wall is at most 1 house in 3 in a hẻm of homes, and at most 1 in 2 on a street near the beach. Two neighbor houses do not have the same color. The colors with the source "builder" are first values that the owner checks.

metal_roofs.note: The colors of corrugated metal sheets in a dense hẻm (R10c): mint or teal, rust, orange or tan, and some red. The grey and white clusters of the photo are concrete roof terraces and walls, not metal (D-0004-03): they are in "terraces".
metal_roofs.source: top-down photo of a dense hẻm, 2026-10-24

terraces.note: The colors of flat concrete roof terraces: the grey and white clusters of the top-down photo of a dense hẻm (R10c, D-0004-03).
terraces.source: top-down photo of a dense hẻm, 2026-10-24

scooters.note: The paint colors of the scooters (plan 0023, R9a): white, red, black, gray, dark blue, and pastel colors. The weights are the share of each color. The source "builder" means a first value that I check.

far_fronts.note: Report 0009, D-0009-15: the color of a wall of the far boxes of the town (tools/geo/geodata/town.py) is the mean of its front from far: the paint, with the dark of its openings. A storey over the ground floor has the share upper_openings of dark: the window of the house kit of plan 0004 (tube_house.gd: 0.5 times the width of the house, from 0.9 m to 2.4 m, in a storey of 3.2 m) is 23 %, and the shade of the balconies about 5 %. The ground floor (one storey of storey_m) has the share ground_openings: the open front of a shop is 2.6 m high across the front (81 % of the storey), and about half of the ground floors of the town are shops. dark is the glass and the room behind it, and the inside of an open shop, seen from far (builder, check).
far_fronts.source: builder, from the house kit of plan 0004; check against the photos of PT-68

far_roofs.note: Report 0009, D-0009-15: the roof colors of the palette are measured from aerial photos, so they have the light of the sun in them already, and the game lights them again: a far box multiplies its roof color by light (the sRGB values), as the far roofs of the ground shader do (terrain.gdshader: 0.46 to 0.6, plan 0005, D-0005-09). With 0.6, the town of the view nui_nho_top of PT-68 at 12:00 has the mean value 0.68 and 19 % near white (its photo 0.61 and 16 %); with 1.0, 0.75 and 35 %.
far_roofs.source: builder, the factor of the far roofs of the ground shader
